campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=50, weight-8, unrestricted

bar.note: Cell frontier entry (exact); unrestricted weight-8 cell already has high-k entries.

novelty.claim: Extend the unrestricted weight-8 frontier beyond (k=50,d=10,n=184); not the first systematic k~50 probe in this cell.
